Preview privacy notice

Updated October 4, 2026. Version 2026-10-04-preview-v1. This describes the current preview, not a finalized production policy. VisaThreads is the service name; the legal operator, business address, retention periods and staffed rights procedures still require confirmation before public launch.

Notice before you create an account

We process your email address, account identifier and authentication information to create and secure your account. A public pseudonym is created for you. We record the policy version you acknowledge, your account ID, a server timestamp, U.S. community context and adult-eligibility confirmation. We do not need your full birth date, passport, Social Security number, immigration case number or payment information to register. Acknowledging this notice is not consent to advertising, a charge or a waiver of privacy rights.

What the app handles

Supabase handles login email, password authentication, account identifiers and sessions. The community database stores public pseudonyms, questions, answers, votes, conversations, messages, read status and abuse reports. Cloudflare hosts the website. These providers may process network, device and security logs when you connect.

Public and restricted information

Questions, replies, public handles and their activity are public. Login email is not included in the app’s public profile views. Message access is restricted by conversation membership; messages are not end-to-end encrypted. Reports disclose the reported content to authorized moderators. Infrastructure administrators can access stored records. Public text and external source links may identify you despite a pseudonym.

Why information is processed

The app uses these records to authenticate accounts, display discussions and matching topics, deliver conversations, prevent abuse and review reports. Related questions use text and topic matching, not a legal eligibility assessment. The reviewed app does not implement advertising pixels, payments or a marketing mailing list. Provider processing and any future analytics or advertising must be reviewed and disclosed before activation.

Browser storage, advertising and sale/sharing

The login client persists session tokens in browser storage to keep you signed in. Demo mode stores sample activity locally. Optional analytics, ads, marketing integrations and payments are off. We do not currently sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track do not enable any optional processing. This is not a claim that providers collect no network data or that a future advertising opt-out system is implemented. Future monetization requires review and updated disclosures before activation.

Cookies and storage{' · '}Your privacy choices

Imported discussions

The development archive contains post text and available comments collected through Apify from the configured source. Profile objects and photos are excluded; public handles and some identifying text are replaced or masked. Masking is incomplete and is not full anonymization. Source content is not automatically synchronized or removed when changed on its original site.

Retention, deletion and requests

There is not yet a self-service export/deletion flow or an approved automatic retention schedule. Logging out does not delete your account, messages or public posts. Backups, security records and legal preservation duties may require separate handling. Production launch requires a working, identity-verified request process and a published retention schedule.

Current request-channel status

Providers and disclosures

In addition to the hosting and database providers above, Resend is configured to deliver account emails; Gmail currently receives support/privacy correspondence. Apify supplied the imported archive. Provider contracts, processing locations and retention settings require review before launch. Information may be disclosed as legally required, to address abuse or protect rights, or in a lawful business transfer subject to applicable safeguards. Selecting a country page does not guarantee that data stays in that country.

Sensitive information

Do not submit identity documents, credentials, financial details, precise location, medical records or detailed case identifiers. Immigration stories can reveal citizenship, national origin, health or other sensitive information even without a name. We do not offer biometric identification or automated legal-eligibility decisions. Contact us about sensitive information rather than reposting it.

U.S. rights and requests

Depending on your state and which laws apply, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or obtain a copy of data, opt out of sale/sharing, targeted advertising or certain profiling, limit certain sensitive-data uses, appeal a denial and exercise rights without unlawful discrimination. Authorized agents may submit requests where permitted. Applicable statutory deadlines and exceptions govern; acknowledging this notice does not waive rights.

Use the temporary contact channel without creating an account. Proportionate identity verification or proof of agent authority may be needed; do not email identity documents unless a safe and necessary process is arranged. Manual request handling, retention and provider-backup procedures still need operational testing.

Request instructions and appeals

Age and regional requirements

Membership is for adults at least 18 who can legally agree to the terms where they live. Do not register a child. An age checkbox is self-attestation, not proof of age; report suspected child accounts or child personal data through the contact channel. The initial community focuses on the United States. Your residence, citizenship and legal rights are not determined by which country page you choose.

Changes and security

Material changes will be published under a new policy version with renewed acknowledgement or separate consent where required. Prior acceptance does not authorize unrelated future uses. Access controls and transport security reduce risk but cannot guarantee absolute security.

Contact VisaThreads
Read community safety guidance

Terms and conditions — early access

Updated October 4, 2026 · Version 2026-10-04-preview-v1

These govern the early-access community only and are not finalized production Terms of Service. VisaThreads is the service name; the legal operator, business address and jurisdiction-specific contract review remain unresolved. No agreement to future charges, advertising or a future contract is implied.

Eligibility and your account

You must be at least 18 and legally able to agree where you live. Keep credentials and verification codes private, use an email you control, and do not impersonate others or evade restrictions. A verified email does not verify professional qualifications. Review these terms and the privacy notice before affirmatively agreeing.

Share experiences responsibly

VisaThreads is an independent peer community, not a government website, law firm or verified legal referral service. Do not present guesses as official rules. Cite official sources and dates when possible; accepted answers and topic matches are not legal verification.

Do not harm other members

No harassment, threats, impersonation, doxxing, scams, sexual exploitation, nonconsensual intimate content, forged documents or instructions to falsify applications. Do not request passports, account credentials, verification codes or payments for guaranteed visa outcomes. Do not evade blocks, suspensions or posting limits.

Respect content ownership

Publish only material you created or have permission or another lawful basis to share. Do not copy private-group conversations or other people’s identifying documents. Public availability, an API subscription and a source credit do not by themselves grant republication rights. No license to third-party imported material is granted by this website.

Recommendations and promotions

Disclose employment, payment, referral fees or other material connections when recommending services. Do not publish unsolicited advertisements, fake reviews or misleading claims of professional qualifications. An imported promotional label is a classification, not VisaThreads’s endorsement.

Your content and permission to operate

You retain ownership of what you submit. You give the operator a nonexclusive, royalty-free permission to host, store, reproduce, display and distribute it only as needed to operate the service, including delivery to recipients you select and safety review. This is not permission to sell private messages or use your identity in advertising. Removal is subject to lawful retention and copies already delivered to others.

Reports, removal and appeals

Use Report on supported content, Block in a conversation, or the contact channel without an account. Content may be removed and accounts restricted for safety, legal obligations or these rules. A report does not guarantee immediate review or emergency assistance. You may request reconsideration by identifying the decision and explaining your appeal. Repeated copyright infringement can lead to account termination where appropriate.

Do not download or resend intimate images or suspected child sexual abuse material. Provide a location link and description. A staffed statutory removal process and designated copyright agent where needed remain launch requirements; these terms do not by themselves establish DMCA safe-harbor eligibility.

Free preview and future paid services

The preview has no paid plans, purchases or advertising integration. Account creation does not authorize a charge. Future pricing, taxes, renewal terms, cancellation, refunds and separate purchase consent must be disclosed before purchase. Existing free accounts will not automatically become paid subscriptions. Sponsored content must be identifiable.

Availability, responsibility and leaving

The preview can change, contain errors or become unavailable. Verify government rules and deadlines independently; keep your own important records. We do not guarantee accuracy, uninterrupted service or absolute security. Nothing here excludes liability or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded. These preview terms impose no mandatory arbitration or class-action waiver.

You may stop using the service, sign out and request account deletion. Sign-out alone does not delete data. Material changes will be versioned and presented for acknowledgement or separate consent where required. Country expansion requires local review; selecting a country page does not change your rights.
